text: Radiological Sciences Dictionary ix Preface The Radiological Sciences Dictionary is meant as an easy reference book for all hospital staff employed in diagnostic imaging, including established radiologists, nuclear medicine physicians, doctors in training, physicists, radiographers and technicians.
text_raw:
Radiological Sciences Dictionary ix
Preface
The Radiological Sciences Dictionary is meant as an easy reference
book for all hospital staff employed in diagnostic imaging, including
established radiologists, nuclear medicine physicians, doctors in
training, physicists, radiographers and technicians.

In solid compounds
or crystals, the energies of the orbitals change

text: The bands are: ● The ‘valence band’, where the valence elec- trons are found. ● The ‘conduction band’, where there are both electrons and spaces for more electrons.

The bands are:
● The ‘valence band’, where the valence elec-
trons are found.
● The ‘conduction band’, where there are both
electrons and spaces for more electrons.

text: The electrons are mobile and materials which have a conduction band are the only ones which can conduct electricity at room temperature. ● The ‘forbidden band’ is the range of energies between two energy bands which is not occu- pied by electrons.

The
electrons are mobile and materials which have
a conduction band are the only ones which can
conduct electricity at room temperature.

between two energy bands which is not occu-
pied by electrons.

and contain any number of other tags, thus
